Name: Project Fluent
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]A framework for creating Fluent translations (handling plurals, genders, contexts, etc) and providing custom translations for other mods.[/size]

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=6]Other info[/size]
[size=4]You can find the documentation [url=https://hackmd.io/@Shockah/H1q8H-mcc]here[/url].
You can find an actual custom translation mod using this framework [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12639]here[/url].[/size]

You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/ProjectFluent]here[/url].
